description: Patches: makes a drafted fix live — visible in the project's public manifest, which the embedded snippet (or, for redirects, an operator-deployed Worker) reads from the visitor's browser. The audited site's own origin content is never touched. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. Requires an org admin.

patchId.description: The patch id, from list_patches or draft_patch.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: publish_patch
